resources.string: Shows owners, cadastral data, category and cadastral value of the property.
Do owners, address, category (e.g. A/2, A/3) and number of rooms (vani) match reality?
Can you send me the up-to-date cadastral extract?
The official floor plan registered with the cadastre.
Does the layout (walls, windows, doors, extensions) match what you see?
Does the cadastral floor plan match the current state of the property?
Statement that cadastral data and plan match reality. Required for the deed.
Is there a technician\'s statement? Note: this says NOTHING about planning legality.
Is there a cadastral conformity statement signed by a technician?
Confirms the property was built according to its permits. Cadastral conformity does not automatically mean planning legality.
Have a technician compare the municipal permit files with the actual situation.
Has planning conformity been checked through the municipal records?
Confirms the building is safe, hygienic and habitable.
Is there a certificate or segnalazione certificata di agibilità, also after alterations?
Does the property have a certificate of habitability?
Required for sale; gives energy class and estimated consumption.
Is the APE valid (10 years) and does it describe the systems correctly?
Can you show me the valid energy certificate?
Installer\'s declaration that the electrical system meets standards (DM 37/08).
Is there a declaration or a dichiarazione di rispondenza? From when?
Does the electrical system have a conformity declaration?
Declaration that the gas system was installed safely and to standard.
Is there a declaration, and was the boiler recently serviced (libretto)?
Is the gas system certified and when was the boiler last serviced?
All permits for construction and alterations of the property.
Are there permits for all alterations and do they match the situation?
Which building permits exist for the property and the works carried out?
Extensions, verandas and outbuildings are often built without permits (abuso edilizio).
Is every extension permitted or legalised (condono, sanatoria)?
Are all extensions and outbuildings legal or legalised?
Who the owners are and how they became owners (purchase, inheritance).
Will all owners sign? Has any inheritance (successione) been fully settled?
Who are the owners and has the inheritance been settled?
Rights of others over the plot, such as passage, pipes or drainage.
Are servitù in the deed or on the map? Are there third-party paths or pipes?
Are there easements such as rights of way on the land?
Mortgages, liens or other charges on the property.
Have the notary run a visura ipotecaria and check how charges will be cancelled.
Are there mortgages or other charges on the property?
Cadastral map with the plot boundaries (estratto di mappa).
Do fences and walls match the map? Which parcels are included in the sale?
Can you provide the cadastral map with all parcels included in the sale?
Official regional/basin maps show flood hazard.
Is the plot in a hazard zone? A visual inspection does not prove there is no risk.
Is the property in a flood-risk area according to the PAI?
Official maps (PAI, IFFI) show known landslides and hazard zones.
Is the plot or access road in a landslide zone? Ask for a geological report if in doubt.
Are there known landslides or hydrogeological restrictions in the area?
The seismic zone of the municipality (1 high – 4 low).
Which zone is the municipality in? Has strengthening been carried out?
Which seismic zone is the municipality in and has the house been strengthened?
Costs for shared parts (condominium, shared road, shared well).
How much per year? Are there approved but unpaid works or arrears?
What are the annual shared costs and have works already been approved?
Obligations to maintain roads, retaining walls, ditches or woods.
Do you have to contribute to a private road, retaining wall or consorzio?
Are there maintenance obligations for private roads, walls or a consortium?
The right to reach the house by road, especially when the road crosses someone else\'s land.
Is access via a public road or via a registered right of way?
Is access to the house via a public road or a right of way?
Why is the house being sold?
How long has the house been on the market?
How long has the house been empty?
When was it last lived in?
Are there any known damp problems?
Have there been roof leaks in the past?
Does the actual layout match the official documents?
What are the annual heating costs?
Is the house connected to the municipal sewer?
Are there problems with access in winter?
Where does the water come from: mains or private well?
Does the septic tank have a discharge permit and when was it emptied?
How old is the boiler and when was it serviced?
Which works have been carried out in the last ten years?
Have building incentives such as the Superbonus been used?
Is there asbestos (eternit) present or has it been removed?
Have there ever been floods or landslides?
Can you point out the plot boundaries?
What is included in the sale (furniture, kitchen, land)?
How much is the agency fee for the buyer?
Are all documents ready for the notary?
Who are the neighbours and are the neighbouring houses occupied?
Have other offers already been made?
May I view the property again, possibly with a technician?
